sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Learn about deductions for investments, insurance, personal super contributions, foreign pensions and financial advice.

Deductions you can claim for the costs of earning interest, share dividends, or income from other investments.

Deductions for the premiums you pay for insurance against the loss of your employment income.

Deductions you can claim for personal super contributions.

Deductions from foreign pension or annuity income that has an undeducted purchase price.

Deductions you can claim for fees you pay to a financial adviser.
